mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_schedule_items (user_id, schedule_date, start_minute, end_minute, timezone, source_type, source_id, title_snapshot, status, color_key) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{schedule_date}, #{start_minute}, #{end_minute}, #{timezone}, #{source_type}, #{source_id}, #{title_snapshot}, #{status}, #{color_key});
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_schedule_items SET schedule_date = #{schedule_date}, start_minute = #{start_minute}, end_minute = #{end_minute}, timezone = #{timezone}, source_type = #{source_type}, source_id = #{source_id}, title_snapshot = #{title_snapshot}, color_key = #{color_key}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user_id};
UPDATE daily_schedule_items SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user_id};
UPDATE daily_schedule_items SET delete_flg = 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user_id};
